question: ttft
answer:
- **Time to first token (TTFT).** `stream_chat()` starts `time.perf_counter()` just before opening the streaming POST. It uses `_delta_text()` to extract content and reasoning from each streamed delta. The first nonempty delta of either kind sets `ttft_s`. The first visible content and first exposed reasoning are also timed separately. Each nonempty delta updates `last_token_s`. [src/nvidia_ai/llm.py](src/nvidia_ai/llm.py:97)
- **Tokens per second.** `stream_chat()` reads `completion_tokens` from the provider’s usage data. The `ChatResult.decode_tps` property divides that count by `last_token_s - ttft_s`, giving a client-observed generation rate. It skips measurements below the minimum token count or generation duration. `ChatResult.e2e_tps` divides the same count by `total_s`, the successful attempt’s elapsed time through stream closure, including TTFT. [src/nvidia_ai/llm.py](src/nvidia_ai/llm.py:73) · [Usage and timing](src/nvidia_ai/llm.py:161)
- **Reporting.** `summarize()` takes median TTFT across successful benchmark runs and median throughput across successful runs of the `long` prompt. `_with_retries()` tracks retry and backoff time separately in `observed_s`. [src/nvidia_ai/bench.py](src/nvidia_ai/bench.py:238) · [Retry handling](src/nvidia_ai/bench.py:111)
